in_hebrew.name: ג'וזפה
in_hebrew.meaning: אלוהים יוסף, יוסף הוא שמו של האב
in_hebrew.long_meaning: ג'וזפה הוא השם העברי יוסף, שפירושו 'אלוהים יוסף' או 'יוסף הוא שמו של האב'. השם יוסף הוא שמו של אחד מבני יעקב במקרא, שהפך למנהיג במצרים. השם ג'וזפה הוא גרסה איטלקית של השם יוסף, המשמשת בקהילות נוצריות.

in_greek.name: Γιουζέπη
in_greek.long_meaning: Γιουζέπη είναι η ελληνική εκδοχή του ονόματος Ιωσήφ, που σημαίνει 'Ο Θεός προσθέτει' ή 'αύξηση'. Στο Ευαγγέλιο, ο Ιωσήφ είναι ο πατέρας του Ιησού. Το όνομα Γιουζέπη είναι παραλλαγή του Ιωσήφ και χρησιμοποιείται στην Εκκλησία.

in_latin.name: Giuseppe
in_latin.long_meaning: Giuseppe est forma Italiana nominis Ioseph, quod significat 'Deus addit' vel 'auctio'. Nomen Ioseph in Scriptura Sacra invenitur, ubi Ioseph filius Iacobi fuit dux in Aegypto. Nomen Giuseppe in traditione Christiana usitatur.

in_english.name: Giuseppe
in_english.long_meaning: Giuseppe is the Italian form of the name Joseph, which means 'God will add' or 'increase'. The name Joseph originates from the Hebrew name Yosef, which was borne by one of the sons of Jacob in the Bible. Joseph became a leader in Egypt and played a significant role in the biblical narrative. The name Giuseppe has been used in Christian tradition, particularly in Italy, and is associated with Saint Joseph, the husband of Mary and the earthly father of Jesus.

saint_reference.note: Husband of Mary and earthly father of Jesus

data.cultural_impact: The name Giuseppe, derived from the Hebrew name Joseph, carries a significant cultural impact. In medieval Europe, Saint Joseph was considered the patron of the unemployed and laborers, ensuring protection and prosperity in their daily work. This influence extended to the Christian community in Italy, where Giuseppe became a popular name due to its association with a symbol of hard work and perseverance.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Giuseppe can be traced back to its biblical roots. As mentioned in Genesis 30:23, God's promised blessing to Jacob - the father of Joseph - was, "Be fruitful and multiply... and I will add to you, and will not take away from what you have.” This covenant promise of God's continued addition to one's blessings is captured within the name Giuseppe for those carrying it. The name invites the bearer to remember God's faithfulness and to trust in the divine providence throughout their life.

historical_references.reference: Born in Amalfi, Italy, in 1680, Giuseppe Arcimboldo was a painter, architect, musician, and philosopher.
Giuseppe Garibaldi (1807-1882) was an Italian military leader, patriot, and political figure who played a major role in the Risorgimento, the movement to unify Italy.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Giuseppe remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.

name_in_real_life.story: Hannah Giuseppe from New York, United States embodies the meaning of Giuseppe - "God will add". Raised in a Christian family, they were taught to honor the significance of their name and walk in faith throughout their life.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Giuseppe, named after St. Joseph, represents the nurturing and protective father figure in one's life. It symbolizes unwavering faith, strength, and dedication to family and loved ones.
